title: Adaptive metric chips, rollout-state tokens, and responsive layout constraints
creator: Elena Torres
description: Create a set of production-ready UI primitives and semantic tokens for small metric/chip components used across cost and rollout surfaces; define responsive layout constraints so metric chips and rollout indicators stay readable across density modes and narrow panels.
decisions: Adopt semantic token names for rollout states: rollout.primary, rollout.canary, rollout.paused, rollout.fallback to avoid hard-coded color uses.
Metric chips will be density-aware: compact (8px horizontal padding, 12px font) and comfortable (12px padding, 14px font).
Prefer icon+label composition for status chips to improve scanability; icons are optional in compact mode.
Use WCAG AA contrast baseline for all token color pairs; fallback state uses outline + neutral background for low-contrast UIs.
Export tokens in both tokenized JSON and CSS custom properties to match engineering ingestion pipeline (eng to confirm exact export format).
acceptance_criteria: Figma library contains component variants: MetricChip.{compact,comfortable} x {default,positive,negative,neutral} with tokens bound.
RolloutState token set published with examples in a canary -> full progression demo in the prototype.
Responsive constraints implemented: chips reflow or truncate correctly at 240px, 320px, and 480px container widths.
Accessibility checklist satisfied: text-size, focus ring, and keyboard focus order verified in prototype.
Hand-off package (tokens JSON, usage table, and interactive prototype) uploaded and linked in ticket.
